events.working_title: Trinity's capture and breakout in Room 303
events.why_here: The unit opens with the cops breaching Room 303 and closes once Trinity has turned her arrest into a massacre and stands alone over the dead; the next scene shifts to the Agents arriving outside, answering a new question about who is closing in on her.

events.working_title: The Agents split to hunt her
events.why_here: After the room is cleared, the story pivots to the Agents' arrival and their decision to divide — Brown into the building, Smith to the alley — setting up a fresh pursuit rather than continuing the completed fight.

events.working_title: Trinity's flight to the exit phone
events.why_here: This run is one continuous escape — the compromised hardline, the climb up the fire escape and across the rooftops, the fall into the stairwell, and the final race to the street phone — and it closes only when she jacks out and the Agents are left with the name 'Neo,' a wholly new situation.

events.working_title: Neo is summoned and drawn toward the truth
events.why_here: The story cuts to a new protagonist and question as 'Wake up, Neo' and 'Follow the white rabbit' pull him out of his routine and into Trinity's warning at the party; it ends once she names 'the Matrix' and vanishes, leaving him committed to the search.

events.working_title: Neo's failed escape from Meta CorTechs
events.why_here: The next morning's lateness, Rhineheart's ultimatum, and Morpheus's guided flight through the office form one unit of attempted escape that ends when Neo's nerve breaks on the ledge and he climbs back inside to be caught — a different question than the chase itself.

events.working_title: Neo is taken and interrogated by the Agents
events.why_here: His capture at the curb and the interrogation — the deal, the sealed mouth, the implanted bug — function as one confrontation that ends with his body violated and fully in their control; the following scene resets him awake at home, unsure what was real.

events.working_title: Neo chooses to meet Morpheus and is taken by the crew
events.why_here: Waking from the ordeal, Neo accepts Morpheus's call, is collected by Trinity on the bridge, and — after resisting in the car — voluntarily stays with the crew as they drive into the 'wet underworld,' completing his transition from hunted suspect to willing initiate.

events.working_title: The Bug Extraction
events.why_here: Inside the moving car the situation narrows to a single physical operation — finding and pulling the tracker from Neo's body — and ends the moment the bug hits the pavement and reverts to a wire tap, after which the journey resumes.

events.working_title: Arrival at the Lafayette and the Red Pill
events.why_here: The car stopping behind the hotel begins the approach to Morpheus, the choice of pills, and the trace that locates Neo; swallowing the red pill and being tracked down through the liquefying mirror is one continuous action that ends when the signal fires and Neo is swallowed into darkness.

events.working_title: Waking in the Pod and Recovery
events.why_here: Neo's body rupturing free of the amnion pod, being disconnected by the machine, flushed through the waste lines, snatched from the sewer, and finally dropped onto the hovercraft floor where Morpheus welcomes him, is one unbroken physical passage out of the machine; it closes when he passes out after hearing 'Welcome to the real world.'

events.working_title: Waking Aboard the Nebuchadnezzar
events.why_here: Regaining consciousness, learning the crew found him, being rebuilt and told the year is closer to 2197, and being led up to the main deck form the recovery-and-orientation phase; it ends once Neo reaches the main deck, where the crew and the next lesson await.

events.working_title: The Construct and the Desert of the Real
events.why_here: Jacking Neo into the Construct to show him the truth of the Matrix — the scorched world, the fetus fields, the battery reality — is one sustained revelation that ends only when he is pulled back to the main deck, physically rejects what he has seen, and collapses.

events.working_title: The Prophecy of the One
events.why_here: Neo, recovered and asking to go back, is instead reframed by Morpheus as part of a lifelong prophecy — the situation changes from surviving the truth to being enlisted in a quest.

events.working_title: Morning and the Operator
events.why_here: A rest period ends and a new day of training begins; Tank arrives to introduce himself and Zion, answering a different question — who will guide Neo now — than the prophecy did.

events.working_title: I Know Kung Fu
events.why_here: Training begins in earnest with the loading of combat skills and the sparring match that teaches Neo the rules are mental, ending when Morpheus lands a blow and orders the next program — the jump.

events.working_title: The Jump
events.why_here: The training moves from combat to the leap across rooftops; the event carries through Neo's failed jump and its aftermath, ending when he learns that death in the Matrix kills the body — the final lesson of the session.

events.working_title: Trinity and Cypher
events.why_here: The training arc closes and the story turns to its crew: Trinity's private moment with the sleeping Neo, followed by Cypher's probing about her feelings and his suggestion to take Neo to the Oracle — a new thread of suspicion and plotting.

events.working_title: The Agent Training Program
events.why_here: This is a self-contained lesson (Agents are programs, they can be anyone, Neo can surpass them) that ends when Tank's call interrupts; the next scene abruptly cuts to the ship fleeing a Sentinel, changing the situation from instruction to survival.

events.working_title: The Sentinel Attack and the E.M.P. Wait
events.why_here: The ship's wake, the alarm, the order to hide, the crew freezing in silence while the machine passes, and their relief form one continuous survival sequence; the next scene settles the ship into quiet sleep, ending the threat.

events.working_title: Cypher's Late-Night Undermining
events.why_here: After the ship goes quiet, Cypher gets Neo alone and sows doubt about Morpheus and the One; the next scene cuts to Cypher already in league with Agent Smith, shifting from private sabotage to the betrayal deal itself.

events.working_title: Cypher's Deal with Smith
events.why_here: The negotiation with Agent Smith, culminating in the offer to trade Morpheus for reinsertion, is a complete unit of betrayal; the next scene returns to the ship's mess hall and the decision to visit the Oracle, a new direction.

events.working_title: The Decision to Visit the Oracle and the Jump-In
events.why_here: Morpheus announcing the Oracle trip, the crew strapping in, and their arrival in the Matrix ("We're in") form one plan-and-execution unit; the next scene has them stepping out into the Matrix and Cypher planting the phone, beginning the journey proper.

events.working_title: Back in the Matrix and the Drive to the Oracle
events.why_here: Re-entering the Matrix, Cypher dropping the connected phone, and the car-ride conversation about identity and the Oracle form one continuous journey beat; the next scene is a static establishing shot of the destination building, pausing the movement.

events.working_title: Entering the Building and the Elevator Confession
events.why_here: Arriving at the building, moving through it, and the elevator ride where Morpheus reveals the Oracle told him he'd find the One form one unit of approach and mounting tension; the next scene stops at the door to the Oracle, where Neo balks.

events.working_title: The Door and the Waiting Room
events.why_here: Neo's resistance at the door, Morpheus's plea of faith, and Neo's agreement to enter lead directly into the waiting room where he learns the spoon lesson and is finally summoned; together they complete the arrival at the Oracle.

events.working_title: The Oracle's verdict
events.why_here: The reading and its immediate, secret aftermath form one beat—Neo learns he is not the One and that Morpheus will die for him; the cut to the car starts the journey home under that new burden.

events.working_title: The uneasy ride back to the exit
events.why_here: The group's return through the Matrix holds together until they step out onto the street; Cypher's shift from warm to sweating signals the ambush closing, and the next scene cuts to the ship where the trap is already springing.

events.working_title: The trap is sprung and Mouse is killed
events.why_here: From Tank's first flicker of alarm through the black cat, the severed hardline, the bricked-up windows, and Mouse's death, this is one continuous ambush; it resolves when Mouse's body goes still and the flatline sounds, after which the story turns to the survivors' predicament.

events.working_title: The crew realizes they're trapped and Morpheus calls for the building's layout
events.why_here: Morpheus hearing the police below starts the escape problem, which resolves into a plan (find the wet-wall via Tank) — and Smith reporting the kill closes that unit before the Agents regroup.

events.working_title: Guided to the escape hole and the crew descends inside the wall
events.why_here: Tank navigating Morpheus to Room 808 executes the plan from the previous event; the Agents learning the floor and the crew worming into the wall answer 'how do they get out,' which changes once the cops close in on the wall.

events.working_title: The Agents find the jacket; a cop discovers the fugitives in the walls
events.why_here: The hunters regrouping over the discarded jacket and a cop hearing whispers through the plaster shifts the question from 'can they escape unseen' to 'they've been found,' which detonates into the firefight.

events.working_title: Firefight in the wall and the group fights down to the basement exit
events.why_here: The cop opening fire begins the shootout that runs through the wall, Room 608, and into the basement boiler room; it ends once Trinity finds the catch-basin exit and the group drops into the hole, leaving Cypher in the smoke.

events.working_title: Morpheus is overpowered and captured
events.why_here: The fight resolves into Morpheus's capture by the cops, and the cut to Tank's grief-stricken reaction on the main deck closes the question of Morpheus's fate; the following scene moves to a different survivor's escape.

events.working_title: The survivors regroup and learn Morpheus is alive
events.why_here: This run tracks the scattered crew re-establishing contact and confirming Morpheus survived and is being moved; the next scene shifts to Cypher alone reaching the exit, changing the question from regrouping to his separate arrival.

events.working_title: Cypher reaches the TV repair shop exit as the crew follows
events.why_here: The sequence follows Cypher entering the shop and the others crawling in through the ringing phone; it ends when the betrayal erupts into violence, which the next scene begins.

events.working_title: Cypher shoots Tank and Dozer on the main deck
events.why_here: The betrayal turns to open murder on the ship, killing Dozer and downing Tank; the next scene picks up with Trinity realizing the line is dead, shifting from the physical attack to its effect on the crew still in the Matrix.

events.working_title: Cypher reveals his betrayal and murders the jacked-in crew
events.why_here: This is the confrontation where Trinity learns Cypher gave up Morpheus and he kills Apoc and Switch; it closes when Tank shoots Cypher, and the next scene is the quiet aftermath of that intervention.

events.working_title: Trinity and Neo escape and wake aboard the ship
events.why_here: The two share a moment then exit, and Trinity wakes on the main deck to learn the cost; the following scene introduces a new location and party entirely, the Agents arriving at a government building.

events.working_title: The Agents Take Morpheus Into Interrogation
events.why_here: We cut to the enemy as Jones enters the building and begins torturing Morpheus, a new situation answering 'what has become of the captured captain,' distinct from the ship's aftermath.

events.working_title: Deciding Morpheus's Fate — and Neo's Choice to Rescue Him
events.why_here: Back on the ship, the debate over pulling the plug reaches its turning point when Neo rejects letting Morpheus die and commits to a rescue, changing the story's question from 'should we sacrifice him' to 'how do we save him.'

events.working_title: Smith's Conviction and the Crew Re-entering the Matrix
events.why_here: The rescue plan launches — Neo arms up, the crew jacks in, Smith isolates himself with Morpheus, and the building is established — so the situation shifts from deciding to act to the operation being underway.

events.working_title: The Lobby Assault and Rooftop Escape
events.why_here: The infiltration erupts into open combat and runs through the elevator shaft, the rooftop fight with Jones, and the escape by helicopter, one continuous action answering 'can they reach and free Morpheus and get out.'

events.working_title: The rescue of Morpheus
events.why_here: Neo guns down the Agents, rouses Morpheus, and the three begin their escape, culminating in Neo catching the falling Morpheus. The next scene continues that same escape in the helicopter rather than starting a new situation.

events.working_title: The helicopter crash and regrouping on the roof
events.why_here: The doomed helicopter is shed, the trio survives on a rooftop, confirms Neo's identity, and arranges an exit. The next scene shifts to the Agents, who have traced them and are launching a strike — a new phase of pursuit.

events.working_title: The Agents order the strike; Smith lingers
events.why_here: The Agents learn the trio's position and order a Sentinel strike, with Smith breaking from the group. The next scene shows the trio actually reaching and using the exit, answering whether they get out before the strike lands.

events.working_title: The old man revealed as Smith; Neo trapped
events.why_here: Trinity and Morpheus escape through the phones while Smith reveals himself and shoots, leaving Neo alone and cornered in the station. The next scene cuts to the crew reacting to what just happened and trying to direct Neo's flight.

events.working_title: The crew urges Neo to run; he begins to believe
events.why_here: From the hovercraft the crew watches and prods Neo, who hardens into resolve and starts believing. The next scene returns to the station for the physical clash that this resolve precipitates.

events.working_title: Neo and Smith's subway battle
events.why_here: The gunfight, hand-to-hand exchange, and train-set-piece form one continuous duel, ending with Neo escaping up the escalator and Smith in pursuit. This is the final run of scenes given.

events.working_title: The Sentinels Arrive
events.why_here: The story pivots from the Matrix fight to the ship's crisis: losing track of Neo is immediately overtaken by the sentinel attack, which reframes every following scene around the countdown to the E.M.P.

events.working_title: The Chase Through the City
events.why_here: Neo is now a fugitive on the run; these scenes form one continuous pursuit — stealing a phone to call for extraction, Smith revealed as the pursuer, the chase tightening through alleys and markets as Tank searches for an exit and the gunfire closes in.

events.working_title: The Escape to the Fire Escape
events.why_here: Tank's discovery of the hotel exit at Wabash and Lake turns the blind flight into a directed run toward a specific goal; the dead-end alley, the kicked-in door, the apartment gauntlet, and the fire escape all answer the single question of whether Neo can reach that exit.

events.working_title: Cornered at the Hotel / The E.M.P.
events.why_here: Smith's recognition of the Heart O' The City Hotel marks Neo's arrival at the exit and the hunter closing in; the story resolves both the Matrix chase and the sentinel countdown together as the crew reaches the hotel and Morpheus arms the E.M.P.

events.working_title: Neo's Flight Up the Alley to the Hotel
events.why_here: Neo scrambles up the fire escape, bursts through the third-floor window into the hall, and the hull breach tightens the clock on his run — one continuous escape toward the phone. The next scene changes the question from 'will he reach the exit' to 'what waits behind the door.'

events.working_title: Smith Shoots Neo in the Hall
events.why_here: Neo reaches door 303 only to be trapped and gunned down by Agent Smith, who then orders the body checked — a completed killing. The next scene answers whether he is truly gone, shifting from the shooting to the crew's grief.

events.working_title: Grief on the Deck; Trinity's Confession and Kiss
events.why_here: Amid the dying ship, Trinity takes hold of Neo, declares her love, and kisses him believing he can feel it — the emotional response to his death. The next scene answers whether that belief is answered, as the monitors revive.

events.working_title: Neo Returns to Life
events.why_here: An unknown man's eyes snap open and, on the deck, the monitors jump back to life as Trinity screams for Neo to get up — the death is reversed. The next scene answers what his return means, as the crew reads his new perception on the screens.

events.working_title: Neo Sees the Code and Destroys Smith
events.why_here: Now able to see through the Matrix, Neo stops the bullets, enters and bursts out of Agent Smith to destroy him, and the remaining Agents flee — the confrontation resolves decisively. The next scene answers how the crew takes this in, and is jolted by a new blow to the ship.

events.working_title: The Ship Is Overrun; the EMP Fires
events.why_here: Sentinels overrun the deck, Trinity summons Neo, and on her cue Morpheus turns the key, flooding the overflow pit and killing the machines — the siege ends. The next scene answers what survival and aftermath look like, in stillness.

events.working_title: Aftermath and Neo's Declaration to the World
events.why_here: Neo wakes in the quiet hovercraft, then broadcasts a message of freedom to the Matrix before taking flight over the city — the story moves from escape and battle into a resolved, forward-looking close.
